description_en: Removes a specified user from a conference call by calling RemoveMember
description_zh: 调用RemoveMember将指定用户从连麦中踢出
name: RemoveMember

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the conference call. The value consists of letters, digits, and hyphens (-), and is 36 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 连麦唯一标识。由字母、数字和短横线（-）组成，长度为36个字符
parameters.name: conference_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user to be removed. The ID must be unique within the AppId. The value consists of letters, digits, underscores (_), hyphens (-), periods (.), and at signs (@). The value must be 1 to 36 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 被踢者用户ID，在AppId下单独唯一。英文字母、数字、下划线（_）、短横线（-）、小数点（.）和@组成。长度为1到36个字符
parameters.name: to_user_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user who initiates the removal. The ID must be unique within the AppId. The value consists of letters, digits, underscores (_), hyphens (-), periods (.), and at signs (@). The value must be 1 to 36 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 踢人者用户ID，在AppId下单独唯一。英文字母、数字、下划线（_）、短横线（-）、小数点（.）和@组成。长度为1到36个字符
parameters.name: from_user_id
